results.name: Subgroup.transferTransversal
results.source_text:
/-- The transfer transversal. Contains elements of the form `g ^ k • g₀` for fixed choices
  of representatives `g₀` of fixed choices of representatives `q₀` of `⟨g⟩`-orbits in `G ⧸ H`. -/
def transferTransversal : H.LeftTransversal :=
  ⟨transferSet H g, isComplement_range_left (coe_transferFunction g)⟩
results.docstring:
The transfer transversal. Contains elements of the form `g ^ k • g₀` for fixed choices
of representatives `g₀` of fixed choices of representatives `q₀` of `⟨g⟩`-orbits in `G ⧸ H`.

results.name: ZNum.transfer
results.source_text:
scoped macro (name := transfer) "transfer" : tactic => `(tactic|
    (intros; transfer_rw; try simp [add_comm, add_left_comm, mul_comm, mul_left_comm]))
results.docstring:
This tactic tries to prove (in)equalities about `ZNum`s by transferring them to the `Int` world and
then trying to call `simp`.
```lean
example (n : ZNum) (m : ZNum) : n ≤ n + m * m := by
  transfer
  exact mul_self_nonneg _
```

results.name: Informal.informalDefinitionDecl
results.source_text:
macro (name := informalDefinitionDecl)
doc?:(docComment)? attrs?:(attributes)? "informal_definition " name:ident body:declVal : command =>
  `($[$doc?]? $[$attrs?]? def $name : InformalDefinition $body:declVal)
results.docstring:
A placeholder for definitions to be formalized in the future. Docstrings of informal definitions
should outline its mathematical or physical content and specify useful references. Use the attribute
`note_attr_informal` from `Physlib.Meta.Notes.Basic` to mark the informal definition as a note.

results.name: Informal.constantInfoToInformalDefinition
results.source_text:
/-- Takes a `ConstantInfo` corresponding to a `InformalDefinition` and returns
  the corresponding `InformalDefinition`. -/
unsafe def constantInfoToInformalDefinition (c : ConstantInfo) : CoreM InformalDefinition := do
  match c with
  | .defnInfo c => evalConstCheck InformalDefinition ``InformalDefinition c.name
  | _ => panic!
    "Passed constantInfoToInformalDefinition a `ConstantInfo` that is not a `InformalDefinition`"
results.docstring:
Takes a `ConstantInfo` corresponding to a `InformalDefinition` and returns
the corresponding `InformalDefinition`.

results.name: InformalDefinition
results.source_text:
/-- The structure representing an informal definition. -/
structure InformalDefinition where
  /-- The names of top-level commands we expect this definition to depend on. -/
  deps : List Lean.Name
  /-- The tag of the informal definition. This should be unique amongst informal results
    and todo items. -/
  tag : String
results.docstring: The structure representing an informal definition.
